answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable copper-denominated stake before it can trade, and let reputation wander with it: each completed job moves a little stake into a yarrow-style trust score that only grows through verified work over weeks. A sybil attacker must fund a fresh stake for every fake identity and wait out the same slow build-up, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand waiting periods, while one honest agent pays once.
